core.title: Stop Bumper for LCN 2030 Series, LCN-2030-169-N
tags: LCN-2030-169-N Door Closer Stop for LCN 2030 Series Concealed Door Closers

text.description_html:
LCN 2030 Series Door Closer Stop/Bumper

This is the New Style door stop for LCN 2030 Series (LCN Pacer) Concealed Door Closer.

Also available other LCN Door Closer Parts

These stop cushions mount into the door closer track and are held in place with the (2) included set screws.
Must have LCN 2030-3038 new style track.

*Sold Individually
